subject: Collection check-in: wire fallback & VAT / bank evidence request - INV-4591
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@cobaltlabs.com>, treasury@cobaltlabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jul 2029 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Collection check-in: wire fallback & VAT / bank evidence request - INV-4591

Hi Alicia / Treasury team,

Quick follow on invoice INV-4591 (Net 30, due 2029-07-08). We haven't received the remittance in our bank yet — can you confirm whether the payment was initiated and, if so, share the ACH remittance advice or a bank trace (TXN ID) so we can reconcile? Our accounting system is waiting to apply the payment.

If ACH is not moving today, would you consider a same-day wire or virtual card? Either works for us — we can accept a split payment if that helps. Also, to complete tax records: please confirm the payer entity for this payment and attach either your company W-9 (if US) or EU VAT registration number / certificate if you're claiming VAT reverse-charge. That prevents any withholding surprises on our side.

I attached the invoice and a short remittance template (fill the amount + txn id) so we can map it on receipt.

Attachments: INV-4591_invoice.pdf (invoice), remittance_template.csv (blank)

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@cobaltlabs.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: treasury@cobaltlabs.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jul 2029 11:30:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Collection check-in: wire fallback & VAT / bank evidence request - INV-4591

Hi Olga — thanks for the nudge. We kicked off an ACH earlier today from Cobalt Labs (ACH batch reference CL-7239). I attached a screenshot from our bank showing the outgoing entry; it should post within 1-2 business days.

A quick ask from our treasury: what is the exact beneficiary bank full name you have on file? Our bank flagged a beneficiary name mismatch on a previous payment and they want to double-check.

We don't have a VAT ID to supply — we're a US entity. I can get you a completed W-9 by EOD if that helps. If ACH doesn't clear, we can escalate to a wire — let me know preferred wire instructions.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Finance Operations
Cobalt Labs
alicia.ramos@cobaltlabs.com

Attachments: payment_confirmation_screenshot.png

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@cobaltlabs.com>, treasury@cobaltlabs.com
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jul 2029 16:05:10 +0000
Subject: Re: Collection check-in: wire fallback & VAT / bank evidence request - INV-4591

Hi Alicia — appreciate the quick response and the screenshot. Our bank just returned an ACH reject this morning citing an "account name mismatch" (beneficiary name on file: Redwood Inference, Inc.; incoming ACH listed the beneficiary as Redwood AI). That mismatch typically triggers the reject and delays posting.

To avoid further delays, two options:
- Wire (preferred for same-day): beneficiary name must match the account name exactly. Our wire instructions are attached (bank_authorization_form.pdf). If you send a wire, please put INV-4591 in the beneficiary reference and forward the outgoing wire confirmation so we can clear it immediately.
- Virtual card: if you have a supplier card program, we can accept a virtual card; note there is a 2.5% processing fee we can discuss crediting back on next invoice.

If you'd like to proceed with a partial wire now and ACH balance when it clears, we can accept a split remittance. Please advise on which route you prefer and I can have accounting mark the invoice accordingly.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Manager, Billing & Collections
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0147

Attachments: bank_authorization_form.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@cobaltlabs.com>, treasury@cobaltlabs.com
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jul 2029 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Collection check-in: wire fallback & VAT / bank evidence request - INV-4591

Alicia — thanks. We're happy to accept a wire to clear this today. Per Ben's note, please make the beneficiary name exactly "Redwood Inference, Inc." on the wire instruction and include invoice INV-4591 in the beneficiary reference field. Once you send the wire, please forward the confirmation so I can instruct accounting to apply payment immediately and waive any late fee for this single-day issue.

Olga / Ben — please change the invoice status to "Awaiting Wire" in the billing portal and flag DEAL-7821 as "in collections - pending wire". Finance will issue the receipt as soon as the confirmation comes through.

Appreciate the quick coordination — Alicia, if you send the W-9 as mentioned that will finalize our tax file for the year.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Corporate Finance
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
